'''Endor - Death Star II Sealed''' is a sealed format on [[GEMP]] (code <code>endor_dsII_sealed</code>) with a deck size of 40 cards. Its format definition uses the same set list as [[Open]] and marks it as not a game hall format.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="sets" /><ref name="lib" /> GEMP's sealed league type ''Endor - Death Star II Sealed'' uses this format.<ref name="sealedtype" />

== Deck size ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Default deck size on [[GEMP]]
| 40 cards
|}
The GEMP format definition sets a deck size of 40 cards.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="lib" />

== Special rules ==
The GEMP format definitions list these special rules:<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="hall" />
* Once per game, may ▼ a unique battleground not already on table.
